title.narrative: Documentary Evidence Collections Exploitation in Iraq to Support ISIL Prosecutions and Investigations (EU Digitization Project Phase II)

description.narrative: Contract related to: Documentary Evidence Collections Exploitation in Iraq to Support ISIL Prosecutions and Investigations (EU Digitization Project Phase II) - This measure will have two components, both serving the overarching objective of addressing grievances and supporting the post-Da¿esh stabilisation efforts. The first component will build on the mediation and dialogue achievements from previous IcSP[1] supported initiatives by focusing on inclusive and sustainable dialogue between the Iraqi Government and its citizens and facilitating the return of displaced Iraqis to their homes. The second component will continue efforts to preserve evidence related to Da¿esh-related crimes and atrocities, notably the ongoing efforts of UNITAD to build an accessible, comprehensive evidence base to investigate and prosecute Da¿esh crimes. The assistance will, furthermore, support UNITAD¿s investigation into crimes on the grounds of sexual orientation committed against the lesbian, gay, bisexual, and transgender (LGBT) community. It will also provide targeted assistance to investigations and domestic legal proceedings against Da¿esh members to new geographic areas that are currently underexplored in addition to answering requests for assistance from third-states, including EU Member States. [1] The Instrument contributing to Stability and Peace

comment.narrative: UNITADs investigations aim to hold ISIL senior members accountable for the crimes they have committed on the basis of objective evidencebased investigation and analysis and through fair and independent criminal proceedings. To do so the Investigative Team collects preserves and stores evidence in relation to acts of ISIL that may amount to war crimes crimes against humanity and genocide. This work is carried to the highest possible standards to ensure the broadest possible use before national courts and complementing investigations being carried out by the Iraqi authorities or investigations carried out by authorities in third countries at their request.
